description: Hold Babel at 7 until @rollup/plugin-babel can take Babel 8.
The plugin peers @babel/core ^7.0.0 and no published version says otherwise,
so @babel/core@8 cannot be installed at all:
Without this the major is reproposed on every run and sits red, which teaches
us to ignore red. Remove this rule when @rollup/plugin-babel publishes a
version that peers Babel 8 — Renovate will offer the major again by itself.
